meta.tldr:
This Cline release, version 0.0.10, significantly enhances the user experience with improved authentication, error reporting, and onboarding. The headline change is the introduction of OAuth authentication for remote MCP servers, allowing users to securely connect and manage their servers directly from Settings → MCP, with support for both dynamic and pre-registered OAuth clients. This streamlines server management and ensures token invalidation upon configuration changes. 

Major new features include more granular MCP error reporting, which now displays errors on individual servers instead of generic page-level messages, and a new 'Connect a model' notice on the welcome screen that guides users to onboarding or model settings when credentials are missing. Failed turns in chat no longer fail silently; instead, they show an error in the transcript with the underlying cause and a link to relevant settings. 

Important fixes and improvements include consistent reasoning controls across all AI SDK providers, including Ollama, ensuring that effort levels and thinking states are respected. Vertex AI credential refreshes now correctly use the configured fetch, resolving authentication issues behind proxies. The stop button is now more visible and clickable, and new keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+N for new session, Cmd/Ctrl+, for settings, Esc to stop turn) have been added for better navigation. The bundled provider and model catalog has also been refreshed. 

There are no breaking changes in this release, making it a straightforward upgrade. Developers should update to 0.0.10 to benefit from enhanced stability, clearer error diagnostics, and a more intuitive user interface, particularly for those working with remote MCP servers or experiencing authentication issues with Vertex AI.

features.name: Refined Shared System Prompt

features.name: Remote MCP Servers OAuth Authentication
features.description: Remote MCP servers can now authenticate with OAuth from Settings → MCP. Users can authorize a server, see its auth status, and cancel or retry a pending authorization. Support for servers requiring pre-registered OAuth clients (client ID/secret) instead of dynamic registration has been added, and stored tokens are invalidated when a server's client configuration changes.

View auth status, cancel, or retry authorization
Supports pre-registered OAuth clients (client ID/secret)
Invalidates stored tokens on client configuration changes

One-click to onboarding or model settings

Cmd/Ctrl+, for settings

Esc stops current turn
Cmd/Ctrl+N for new session
Cmd/Ctrl+, for settings

key_details: Fixes ADC authentication behind proxies/custom networking for Vertex AI

features.name: Refreshed Bundled Provider and Model Catalog
features.description: The bundled provider and model catalog has been refreshed to include the latest offerings.
key_details: Updated list of available providers and models

breaking_changes.title: Remove Foreground Terminal Mode
breaking_changes.description: Foreground terminal mode has been removed. All task command execution now defaults to background mode, removing the VS Code integrated terminal dependency and related settings UI.
breaking_changes.migration: No migration is required. All task commands will now execute in the background.

breaking_changes.title: Removal of Model-Initiated Plan-to-Act Switching
breaking_changes.description: The model will no longer automatically switch from plan mode to act mode. Switching out of plan mode is now exclusively user-driven.
breaking_changes.migration: Users must now explicitly trigger the switch from plan mode to act mode. The model will no longer make this decision mid-turn.

breaking_changes.title: Hard-blocking File-Editing Shell Commands in Plan Mode
breaking_changes.description: File-editing shell commands are now hard-blocked in plan mode. This includes file manipulation, in-place editors, redirection to files, mutating git subcommands, and package installs. Read-only investigation commands are still permitted.
affected: Shell command execution in plan mode
breaking_changes.migration: Users must switch out of plan mode to execute any shell commands that modify files or system state. Attempting to run such commands in plan mode will result in refusal.

breaking_changes.title: Model-initiated plan-to-act switching removed
breaking_changes.description: Switching out of plan mode is now driven by the user, not by the model deciding mid-turn. This means the model will no longer automatically transition from planning to acting.
breaking_changes.migration: Users will now need to explicitly drive the transition from plan mode to act mode. The model will no longer initiate this switch.
